answer: Proof of Personhood via biometrically anchored tokens forces attackers to bridge the gap between digital identities and physical scarcity. By requiring a unique, verified signature at the ridge of a fingerprint, the network treats anonymous bot clusters as sable shadows against a stable mesa of legitimate participants. An adversary must incur substantial hardware and logistical costs to forge physical presence, rendering the scaling of fake-identity nodes economically irrational and computationally prohibitive.
